release_notes:
## Changes

- Add Apple Music 7.0.2 (build 1624) support to **Browse artist albums in Android Auto**.
- Keep the Pixel Camera Immich patch in the same bundle.
- Update the README with both patches and supported Apple Music versions.

## Validation

The v0.1.6 bundle builds successfully and Morphe applies the Apple Music patch to the Pixel-extracted 7.0.2 APKM. Android Auto behavior was verified on Android 17 with the Desktop Head Unit.
